concerns.text: FR-001 (download bulk RNA‑seq count matrices) is not satisfied – task T064 (GEO downloader) remains incomplete, leaving core data acquisition unmet.
FR-002 (normalization of raw counts) is uncovered – task T014 (normalization script) is still pending, so no VST/TPM normalization step exists.
FR-003 (CPM filtering and variance‑based sub‑selection) lacks implementation – task T015 (gene‑filtering) is open, so required filtering is absent.
FR-004 (pairwise correlation computation) is missing – task T016a (Pearson correlation matrix generation) is not completed, preventing raw correlation scores.
FR-004 (thresholded edge extraction) is missing – task T016b (edge extraction) is pending, so no thresholded edge list can be produced.
FR-005 (mapping gene IDs to STRING protein IDs) is uncovered – task T017 (identifier mapping) remains open, leaving identifier conversion undone.
Constitution I (reproducibility) is violated – the repository skeleton (T001) is not created, preventing a standard project layout.
Constitution I is breached – R environment setup (T003) is missing, which blocks batch‑effect correction that depends on Bioconductor packages.
Constitution I is violated – linting/formatting configuration (T004) is absent, hindering code‑quality enforcement and CI compliance.
Constitution I is broken – CI workflow file (T005) is not provided, so automated reproducibility, citation checks, and schema validation cannot run.
FR-010/FR-034 logging requirements are unmet – central logger module (T006) is not implemented, violating logging and reproducibility principles.
FR-004 and FR-012 parameterization are unsupported – configuration files species.yaml and parameters.yaml (T009) are missing, preventing threshold and seed control.
SC‑006 (schema validation) cannot be satisfied – contract/schema files (predicted_ppi.schema.yaml, evaluation.schema.yaml, etc.) (T010) are absent.
FR-004 lower‑bound enforcement is absent – CLI argument validator (T012) that ensures --threshold ≥ 0.75 is not implemented.
Constitution II (verified accuracy) is violated – citation‑verification step invoking the Reference‑Validator Agent (T013) is missing.
FR-035 (recording command‑line invocation, software versions, seed) is not realized – logger extension (T098) is absent.
FR-004 enforcement cannot be tested – CI test that rejects thresholds < 0.75 (T099) is missing.
Constitution II is breached – CI step running the Reference‑Validator Agent (T100) is not present.
SC‑003 (pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) lacks a concrete verification task; no artifact records or asserts wall‑clock time, making the criterion untestable.
FR-034 (logging schema conformity) cannot be satisfied because the required pipeline_log.schema.yaml is missing (referenced in T010).
FR-035 (record exact command‑line, versions, seed) is not implemented due to missing logger extension.
Sensitivity analysis (T085) omits the mandated lower‑bound threshold 0.75 specified in FR‑004, potentially missing a required sweep.
FR‑014 specifies a fallback to SVA when metadata are incomplete, yet task T065 only implements ComBat; the SVA fallback is absent.
